description: The W46 invoice-orphan fixture: an issued invoice whose appointment_id is NULL — the schema permits it (references ... on delete set null) — while its patient and an unlinked appointment row exist nearby to prove it is the FK link, not the data, that is missing. The shipped send-invoice-email function happily mailed this letter addressed to "undefined undefined" (its optional chaining interpolated the missing appointment.patient); the ported endpoint INNER JOINs appointments/patients, fetchInvoiceDetail returns no row, and it answers the legacy 500 {"success":false,"error":"Invoice not found"} envelope instead. This fixture pins that recorded behavioural deviation in both directions.
usage: Seed block first (patients, appointments, invoices, invoice_items), then POST /api/send-invoice-email with requests[0]. The invoice's created_at (9 Aug 2025) is outside every invoices-CSV window of the other fixtures, and the invoice has no payment, so it cannot disturb a CSV or receipt comparison on a combined scratch database. legacy_inputs.invoice_orphan is what buildInvoiceHtml receives as the shipped-function byte reference; the endpoint's answer is asserted against the body quoted in the contract.

contract.invoice_email: expected old-vs-new diff (W46, the port's one recorded behavioural deviation): buildInvoiceHtml(legacy_inputs.invoice_orphan) DOES produce a letter — the shipped template's ${invoice.appointment?.patient?.first_name} ${...last_name} interpolates to Name: undefined undefined, the Email/Phone/Address and Date/Reason rows fall away on the falsish conditionals, and the item table plus the totals block (Subtotal 15.00, Total 15.00, Outstanding 15.00) render normally. The shipped .single() returned the row with appointment null and mailed it. The endpoint must instead answer 500 with exactly {"success":false,"error":"Invoice not found"} — fetchInvoiceDetail's INNER JOINs yield no row — and must contact no provider and mail nothing.
contract.seeding: appointment_id null is legal by schema (on delete set null); the seeded patient a...0010 and appointment b...0010 are intentionally not referenced by the invoice — the orphan is the missing FK link.
